'''Kantale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] before he joined the radicalized [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Kantale was among the Revanite commanders who led the Revanite forces in defense of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] on the grounds of the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] by forces from the Imperial-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Yavin Coalition]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Kantale appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is one four named enemies that must be defeated by players in the mission "The Enemy Within."<ref name="TOR" />
